newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australis in US$150 mln raising.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australis in US$150 mln raising.

text.p: Australis Media Ltd said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement with two U.S. investment banks for a US$150 million capital raising through a note issue.
Australis said the issue would be made through its subsidiary, Australis Holdings Pty Ltd.

It said it would issue 267.52 units consisting of US$267.52 million principal amount at maturity of the issuer's 15 percent senior secured discount notes due 2002 and warrants to purchase an aggregate of 49.9 million ordinary shares of Australis at an exercise price of A$0.20 per share.

The notes will be guaranteed on a senior secured basis by Australis and all of its direct and indirect subsidiaries, other than Australis Holdings. The notes will not pay cash interest for the first four years, Australis said.
Australis said the sale of the securities comprising the units, notes, warrants and guarantees will be made without registration under the U.S. Securities Act of 1933.

The closing for the issue is scheduled to occur on October 31, 1996 and is subject to a number of conditions precedent, including the completion of equity investments in the company for an aggregate of at least US$100 million, Australis said.
The senior secured discount notes will not be and have not been registered under the U.S. Securities Act of 1933 and may not be offered or sold in the U.S.
Australis described the unnamed U.S investment banks as initial purchasers of the notes.
At 1.15 p.m. (0215 GMT), Australis shares were two cents up at 18.5 cents.
